copy.headline: White Castle vending machine debuts at Dallas Love Field ahead of first Texas location
copy.caption: Travelers at Dallas Love Field can now buy White Castle sliders before their flights. The airport debuted a new White Castle vending machine located between Gate 16 and Chili’s.
